item_short_desc: Ensure your safety and command attention with Rothco's Police Whistle. Designed to deliver a sharp, clear sound, this police-style whistle is ideal for emergency signaling, coaching, or any situation requiring immediate attention. The whistle features a cork pea ball inside, enhancing its sound and effectiveness. The survival whistle comes with a convenient lanyard, allowing you to wear it around your neck or attach it to your gear for easy access.
